subject: Vendor payflow & contract matrix - Helix Health intake
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@helixhealth.com>, procurement@helixhealth.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 15:04:00 +0000
Subject: Vendor payflow & contract matrix - Helix Health intake

Hi Olivia / Helix procurement team,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — great discussion. As promised, a quick post-call recap and suggested next steps so we can lock down the vendor intake path and PO timeline: 

1) Economic owner: you mentioned Markus Vogel will be final approver for AP. Can you confirm his email and whether he requires a one-page cost summary or a formal quote?

2) Procurement gateway: you have a central procurement mailbox (procurement@helixhealth.com). Please confirm whether Legal needs the SOW + security questionnaire before finance will issue a PO, or whether finance can start PO creation in parallel.

3) Invoice routing: example flow we typically see — Redwood issues invoice to AP, Helix creates PO that references our vendor number and routes to payables. Does Helix require net-45, net-60, or a fixed-calendar payment window?

4) Evidence for security: we can attach SOC 2 summary + vendor intake form. Would you prefer those as separate files or combined into one packet for intake?

5) Timeline: suggested internal milestones from our side — SOW + intake form to you within 24 hours; redline turn from Legal within 3 business days; PO issuance target within 7 business days after Legal sign-off. Is that realistic for your team?

Next steps: 
- I will attach a draft SOW and the vendor intake XLSX (see attachments) for Markus / procurement to review.
- Laura (CC) will handle technical onboarding questions; Priyom is our finance lead for billing routing.

Appreciate confirmation on the two gating items above (Markus contact + whether Legal must sign before PO). If helpful, we can schedule a 20-min call with Markus and procurement to walk the process.

Best,

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments (2): redwood-sow-v1.pdf (SOW draft, pages 1-3), vendor-intake-form.xlsx (Vendor intake checklist)
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@helixhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@helixhealth.com, Markus Vogel <markus.v@helixhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Vendor payflow & contract matrix - Helix Health intake

Thanks Ben — useful recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Confirming Markus is the economic approver (markus.v@helixhealth.com). He typically wants an executive summary + one-line list of chargeable items. If you can include a one-page cost summary at the top of the SOW that would speed things up.

- Our procurement policy: Legal review is usually required for any new vendor SOW > $50k. For pilot agreements under $50k we can often proceed with a simplified intake and finance will issue a PO sooner. Can you confirm expected pilot spend?

- Invoice terms: Helix standard is net-45, but we can do net-30 for new strategic partners if finance approves.

- Security evidence: please send SOC 2 summary and the intake form separately — procurement will upload each into our vendor portal. Also: we need a completed W9 and vendor W-9 equivalent (Helix is US-based).

- Timeline: 3 business days for legal redline is optimistic but possible; if Legal is out on leave it can stretch. Procurement suggests we plan for a 10 business day window for PO issuance after SOW finalization to be safe.

Markus — looping you in to confirm the approver expectations. Happy to set a 20-min alignment call this week if that helps.

Best,
Olivia
Head of Partnerships Operations
Helix Health
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 16:45:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: Vendor payflow & contract matrix - Helix Health intake

Laura / Priyom — quick internal note after Olivia's reply: 

- Olivia confirmed Markus (markus.v@helixhealth.com) as economic approver and asked for a one-page cost summary at the top of the SOW. Laura, can you condense the technical deliverables into the SOW's exec summary (1 page) so Markus sees the value props and line items?

- Priyom, Helix flagged net-45 as standard but open to net-30 for strategic partners — can we prepare both payment-term options and indicate preferred? Also they require a W9; I'll attach our W9 when I reply.

- Security docs: procurement wants SOC 2 summary + vendor intake form separately. I attached the intake form already. We should also produce a one-page SOC extract. Priyom, can you grab the latest SOC 2 cover summary and I’ll pull the intake questions into the packet.

- Timeline: plan for a 10 business-day PO issuance after SOW final but propose our optimistic 7-day cadence as a stretch. We'll present both timelines in the email so they can pick.

I'll draft the reply to Olivia including revised SOW and W9. If we want, schedule a 20-min call with Markus Thurs/Fri. Thoughts?

Thanks,
Ben
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@helixhealth.com>, Markus Vogel <markus.v@helixhealth.com>, procurement@helixhealth.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 10:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Vendor payflow & contract matrix - Helix Health intake

Hi Olivia / Markus / procurement team —

Thanks for the clear notes. Attached are: 1) revised SOW with a one-page executive cost summary at the front (redwood-sow-v1.pdf), 2) vendor intake form (vendor-intake-form.xlsx), and 3) Redwood W-9.

Summary of items for your review: 
- Pilot spend: estimated $22,500 over 30 days (line-item breakdown in the cost summary). This keeps the engagement under your $50k threshold for an accelerated intake.
- Payment terms: we propose net-45 (standard) but are open to net-30; please indicate preferred and we will reflect in final SOW.
- Security evidence: SOC 2 cover summary included in the SOW appendix; if procurement would like the full report we can provide it under an NDA.
- Next-step options: 
   • Option A (fast): Sign SOW + intake form -> finance issues PO within ~7 business days.
   • Option B (safe): Sign SOW -> Legal redline window (~3 business days) -> finance issues PO within ~10 business days.

If you'd like to run a brief call to confirm the PO cadence and who will enter the vendor into Helix's portal, I have availability today 16:00-17:00 UTC and Friday 13:00-15:00 UTC.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments (3): redwood-sow-v1.pdf, vendor-intake-form.xlsx, redwood-w9.pdf
